documents.title: Protein Consumption and Alternative Protein Adoption in India and Pakistan
documents.description: Comparative secondary synthesis of the affordability, dietary practice, legitimacy, certification, and policy conditions that shape adoption. Proposes the comparative tests and forecast-question requirements that would follow.

documents.title: Protein Transitions Across Unequal Food Systems
documents.description: Protein supply, consumer adoption, public research and talent policy, and institutional capabilities. Includes country data, charts, locators, and a cited-passage ledger.

documents.title: AI and the Protein Transition
documents.description: Evidence connecting technical progress, adoption, displacement, animal outcomes, and policy under uncertainty. Includes an annotated library and RIS bibliography.

documents.title: Policy Evidence to Decision Table
documents.description: Six conditional policy choices, the evidence relevant to each, and reasons to revise them. These proposals have not been evaluated or adopted.

documents.title: Alt-Protein and Food-Systems Orientation
documents.description: Technology, capital, talent, regulation, and foresight practice, with source links preserved from the original briefing.

documents.title: Alt Protein Without the Jargon
documents.description: An introduction to the production tracks, value chain, market definitions, and technical vocabulary, with private project instructions removed.
